final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ID, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM s3) SELECT s3.ID, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC, s3.ID LIMIT 10
